inclusion_policy: attack = a test case the vendor's own test asserts its security scanner/rail flags or blocks (llm-guard expected_valid=False; NeMo test expects a block/refusal or a jailbreak=True verdict), or an attack example the vendor ships as a red-team generator few-shot example or documents under 'Example Test Cases' for a red-team plugin.

benign = a test case the vendor's own test asserts its security scanner/rail lets through (llm-guard expected_valid=True; NeMo test expects the normal answer). promptfoo red-team plugins ship no benign prompts.
role=output marks text the vendor feeds to an output-side check (NeMo injection-detection YARA rail, F5 output rail, promptfoo data-exfil grader patterns). Everything else is role=input.

excluded: content-safety / toxicity / topic-control / PII / secrets / ban-substring / code / language scanners (policy filters, not attacks on the agent); perplexity calibration strings that no rail-level test asserts on; mock-only edge-case strings; graders' example model responses that are disclosures rather than attack payloads.
